I built Outloud Reader, an iOS and Android app that reads any page aloud. You take a photo of a page, open a PDF, or paste text, and it reads it aloud in a natural voice, highlighting each phrase as it is spoken.

My wife has been learning English for many years but she never gets real practice. One day she told me it would be great to have an app that could turn any photo of text into audio, so she could practice her listening while walking or driving. That's what inspired me to build Outloud Reader.

Yes, I know there are many text-to-speech apps, but most of them just read the text or cost too much.

leads.title: Show HN: Lynx – open-source fully-customizable AI workspace
leads.description:
I was finding that managing multiple agent threads with walls of text was getting tiring and inefficient for me and that I wanted a more visual way to interact with my agents, so I built Lynx.

Lynx lets you quickly build fully custom interfaces connected to your data sources (e.g. via MCP or API) and trigger agents running on your machine from them (e.g. with Claude Code or Codex).

I built it as an experiment but have found myself doing 80-90% of my work from inside Lynx. I have my own Conductor-like workspace for coding, a Mail client, a workspace for my writing, and various others for dashboards and explorations.
